facts.fact: CPJ reports Zambia's 2025 Cyber Crimes Act is in force, with Section 10 prohibiting recording a private conversation without prior notice and carrying up to two years in prison or a fine of up to 200,000 penalty units.

CPJ, citing his lawyer and a police statement, reports ZNBC journalist MacPherson Mukuka has been detained at Kabwata Police Station since 17 July 2026 over an alleged violation of Section 10 of the 2025 Cyber Crimes Act for publishing a secret audio recording.
